import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_square_residues_0 (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2) % 3 = 0 ∨ (n ^ 2) % 3 = 1 := by
  have h : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases h with h | h | h <;> simp [Nat.pow_mod, h]

  have h2 : n ^ 2 % 7 = ((n % 7) ^ 2) % 7 := by

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_no_root_mod_0 (n : ℕ) : ¬ (4 ∣ n ^ 2 + 13) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, n = 2 * m ∨ n = 2 * m + 1 := ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩
  rcases hm with rfl | rfl
  · have h2 : (2 * m) ^ 2 = 4 * (m * m) := by ring
    omega
  · have h2 : (2 * m + 1) ^ 2 = 4 * (m * m + m) + 1 := by ring
    omega

theorem qsm_no_root_mod_1 (n : ℕ) : ¬ (8 ∣ n ^ 2 + 6) := by
  intro h
  have h1 : (n ^ 2 + 6) % 8 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
  have h2 : n ^ 2 % 8 = ((n % 8) ^ 2) % 8 := Nat.pow_mod n 2 8
  have h8 : n % 8 = 0 ∨ n % 8 = 1 ∨ n % 8 = 2 ∨ n % 8 = 3 ∨ n % 8 = 4 ∨
      n % 8 = 5 ∨ n % 8 = 6 ∨ n % 8 = 7 := by omega
  generalize n ^ 2 = m at h1 h2
  rcases h8 with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
    (rw [h] at h2; norm_num at h2; omega)

rows.name: qsm_pow_div_0
rows.proof:
import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_pow_div_0 (n : ℕ) : 13 ∣ 3 ^ (3 * n) - 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : (3:ℕ) ^ (3 * (k + 1)) = 27 * 3 ^ (3 * k) := by
      rw [show 3 * (k + 1) = 3 * k + 3 by ring, pow_add]
      ring
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (3:ℕ) ^ (3 * k) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
    rw [h1]
    generalize (3:ℕ) ^ (3 * k) = a at *
    omega

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_pow_div_1 (n : ℕ) : 7 ∣ 3 ^ (6 * n) - 1 := by
  have h : ∀ m : ℕ, 3 ^ (6 * m) % 7 = 1 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      have e : 3 ^ (6 * (k + 1)) = 3 ^ (6 * k) * 729 := by
        rw [show 6 * (k + 1) = 6 * k + 6 by ring, _root_.pow_add]
        norm_num
      rw [e]
      omega
  have h1 := h n
  generalize 3 ^ (6 * n) = a at h1 ⊢
  omega

theorem qsm_pow_div_2 (n : ℕ) : 31 ∣ 7 ^ (15 * n) - 1 := by
  have h1 : 7 ^ (15 * n) ≡ 1 [MOD 31] := by
    rw [pow_mul]
    have h2 : (7:ℕ) ^ 15 ≡ 1 [MOD 31] := by
      norm_num [Nat.ModEq]
    simpa using h2.pow n
  exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num))).mp h1.symm

rows.name: qsm_cauchy_0

import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat

theorem qsm_cauchy_0 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (h₁ : f 1 = 0) :
    f 4 = 0 := by
  have h2 : f 2 = 0 := by
    have h := hf 1 1
    rw [show (1:ℝ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num] at h
    linarith
  have h3 : f 3 = 0 := by
    have h := hf 2 1
    rw [show (2:ℝ) + 1 = 3 by norm_num] at h
    linarith
  have h4 := hf 3 1
  rw [show (3:ℝ) + 1 = 4 by norm_num] at h4
  linarith

theorem qsm_cauchy_1 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (h₁ : f 1 = 1) :
    f 2 = 2 := by
  have h : f (1 + 1) = f 1 + f 1 := hf 1 1
  have h2 : (1 : ℝ) + 1 = 2 := by norm_num
  rw [h2] at h
  rw [h, h₁]
  norm_num

theorem qsm_cauchy_2 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (h₁ : f 1 = -3) :

    have := hf 1 1
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  have h3 : f 3 = -9 := by
    have := hf 2 1
    norm_num at this

  linarith
